study: Damped phase memory and retrospective conditioning
status: Internally fixed before executing this extension; not externally preregistered. All four datasets were examined in previous phases.
preexecution_amendment: User clarified that five means an optimum of state degrees of freedom, not a new physical dimension. Before any extension experiments, add matched 3/5/7-real-coordinate bank ablations; this is not a test of a universal optimum for nonlinear dynamical systems.
small_banks: Real: geomspace taus 1/16 through 4, with 3/5/7 states per channel. Phase: one real mode (lambda=1) plus first 1/2/3 complex pairs with lambda=(4,1,16) and omega=4*lambda. Fixed nested phase family. Degrees of freedom are per channel, excluding unchanged Gabriel core and readout parameters.
clock: Known held samples of duration 1/N; record duration 1 in normalized model time. No claim about physical sampling intervals.
real_control: 16 real exponential modes with time constants geomspace(1/16,4,16); same 16 real state coordinates per input channel as 8 complex modes.
initial_state: Zero independently at each record; fixed bank and graph parameters; no memory feedback into graph.
graph: Existing 48-cell trace-only observer, seed 0 and unchanged defaults.
normalization: Per-channel train mean and SD; tanh((x-mu)/(3*sd)); fitted inside each CV fold.
training: Existing 5 stratified training-only folds, seeds 93400+dataset index; ridge penalties [0.0001,0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100,1000]; stronger penalty wins exact CV balanced-accuracy ties.
endpoints: External-label correct counts for every family
Paired gains/losses of phase versus equal-state real control
Conditional retrieval fraction for standalone linear banks
acquisition: Only standalone real and phase banks. Same random_half and middle_half masks as saved prefix experiment; unknown transformed scalars in [-1,1], exact passive retrieval, unit cost. Policies: descending maximum pairwise coefficient magnitude and reverse temporal order. Stop on strict all-rival margin >1e-10; validate every stopped box with Arb at 100 bits, retry 160/256 only if needed.
numerical_checks: Exact-held transition versus real matrix exponential; subdivision; disk invariance; common-input contraction; units covariance; kernel/recurrence; affine box vertices; shared-variable cancellation; counterexamples; Arb validation of all linear stops and all hybrid point predictions.
scope: Controlled extension on reused small datasets; no broad superiority, new domain, learned transfer or new general complex-state-space principle is claimed. No post-test parameter or family selection. Historical experiments retained, not rerun.
